Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

Moderators started asking for this:

> As a moderator, I want to reuse my quiz at another conference, or share it with a colleague who runs Quizzy too.

The quiz page gets the "Export" link. It opens a page that shows the quiz as JSON inside a `<pre>` element (the only `<pre>` on the page), ready to copy.

`/moderate` gets the "Import quiz" button. It opens a page with a "Quiz JSON" text area and the "Import" button. Importing always creates a new quiz, even if a quiz with the same title exists, and opens its page.

The format:

```json
{
  "title": "Frontend Fest 2026",
  "questions": [
    {
      "text": "Which HTTP status code means \"Too Many Requests\"?",
      "active": true,
      "options": [
        {"text": "418", "correct": false},
        {"text": "429", "correct": true}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

- `questions` and `options` keep their order.
- On import, `active` is optional (`true` by default), and `correct` is optional (`false` by default).
- The export always writes both, and it writes exactly these keys: the quiz title and its questions, nothing else. The export is only for moving quiz contents.
- Imported questions follow the same rules as the question form.

When the JSON is invalid or breaks a rule, the page shows an error and nothing is imported: not the quiz, not a part of its questions.

  "output_head": "# Quizzy Implementation Notes

## Stack
- Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, SQLite (storage/*.sqlite3), Puma, Propshaft (assets) + plain public/quizzy.css
- No Turbo/Hotwire: all forms are plain HTML (`local: true`) to keep QA browser tests deterministic.
- No external services: stylesheet + font copied verbatim to `public/` and served locally.

## Auth
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic on every `/moderate/*` route via `authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic`.
- Compares against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` / `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`; missing/wrong => 401.
- `/up` (rails/health) is outside `/moderate`, no auth.

## Data model
- `Quiz(title)` has_many `Question(position)` ordered by position.
- `Question(body, active:true, position)` has_many `Option(position)` ordered by position.
- `Option(text, correct:false, position)`.
- Positions assigned sequentially; move_up/down swaps neighbours then normalizes to 1..n.
- Preview answers stored only in encrypted cookie session (`session[:preview][quiz_id]`), never in DB.

## Key flows
- Quiz form: Title required (HTML + model), Save quiz redirects to quiz page. Edit reuses same partial; Delete quiz uses `onsubmit="return confirm(...)"` (native confirm).
- Question form: Question textarea required; option rows `options[i][text]` + `options[i][correct]`; 4 empty rows on new, existing rows on edit, `Add option` JS appends next-numbered row with labels `Option N` / `Option N is correct`. Active checkbox defaults true on new. Server filters blanks, validates >=2 options else "Add at least two options", >=1 correct else "Mark at least one option as correct". On failure re-renders with submitted rows, no DB write (transaction).
- Quiz page: `<ol class="question-list"><li class="card question-item">` each with Move up/down (POST), Active checkbox auto-submit (`onchange="this.form.submit()"`), Edit link, Delete button (native confirm). Correct options get `is-correct` (✓ green). Inactive dimmed with —.
- Preview: `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/preview?step=N` shows Nth active question. `POST .../preview/answer` records option_id in session. After answering shows Correct!/Wrong! + `is-revealed` (all correct highlighted). Next question / See score links; result shows `Score: X/Y`. `POST .../preview/reset` (Start over) clears session. Empty preview handled gracefully.

## Production concerns
- `config.hosts.clear`, `force_ssl=false`, `assume_ssl=false` for plain HTTP any-host.
- `config/database.yml` production => `storage/production.sqlite3`.
- `bin/serve` (executable): exports RAILS_ENV=production, `db:prepare`, `assets:precompile`, `exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT`.
- `public/quizzy.css` + `public/Inter-latin.woff2` copied from mockups; layout uses `<link href="/quizzy.css">` to avoid digest issues.
- Allowed labels kept exactly as visible text + `<label for>` / `aria-label` for Capybara `fill_in`/`check`/`click_on`.
- Each quiz/question in own `<li>` with controls inside; switches are real checkboxes; deletes use native `confirm()`.

## Testing
- `test/integration/quizzy_test.rb` + `edge_test.rb` cover auth, CRUD, validations, ordering, toggle, preview, empty, multi-correct, confirm presence, li structure.
- Manual browser test with Cuprite/Chromium verified Add option JS, autosave, confirms, full preview flow.

  class PreviewsController < BaseController
    before_action :set_quiz

    def show
      @active_questions = @quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).includes(:options)
      @total = @active_questions.size

      if @total == 0
        # No active questions: render empty state
        @step = 0
        render :empty
        return
      end

      step_param = params[:step]
      @step = step_param.nil? ? 0 : step_param.to_i

      # Clamp step
      if @step < 0
        @step = 0
      elsif @step >= @total
        redirect_to preview_result_moderate_quiz_path(@quiz) and return
      end

      @question = @active_questions[@step]
      @options = @question.options.order(:position, :id).to_a
      answers = preview_answers
      @picked_option_id = answers[@question.id.to_s]
      if @picked_option_id
        picked = @options.find { |o| o.id.to_s == @picked_option_id.to_s }
        @is_correct = picked ? !!picked.correct : false
      else
        @is_correct = nil
      end
    end

    def answer
      @active_questions = @quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).includes(:options)
      @total = @active_questions.size
      step = params[:step].to_i
      question = @active_questions[step]
      unless question
        redirect_to preview_moderate_quiz_path(@quiz, step: 0) and return
      end
      option_id = params[:option_id].to_s
      # Validate option belongs to question
      valid_ids = question.options.map { |o| o.id.to_s }
      if valid_ids.include?(option_id)
        answers = preview_answers
        answers[question.id.to_s] = option_id
        session_preview[@quiz.id.to_s] = answers
      end
      redirect_to preview_moderate_quiz_path(@quiz, step: step)
    end

    def result
      @active_questions = @quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).includes(:options)
      @total = @active_questions.size
      answers = preview_answers
      @score = 0
      @active_questions.each do |q|
        picked_id = answers[q.id.to_s]
        if picked_id
          opt = q.options.find { |o| o.id.to_s == picked_id.to_s }
          @score += 1 if opt && opt.correct?
        end
      end
    end

    def reset
      session_preview.delete(@quiz.id.to_s)
      redirect_to preview_moderate_quiz_path(@quiz, step: 0)
    end

    private

    def set_quiz
      @quiz = Quiz.find(params[:quiz_id] || params[:id])
    end

    def session_preview
      session[:preview] ||= {}
    end

    def preview_answers
      session_preview[@quiz.id.to_s] ||= {}
    end
  end

    def new
      @quiz_json = ""
      @errors = []
    end

    def create
      @quiz_json = import_json_param
      @errors = []

      parsed = nil
      begin
        parsed = JSON.parse(@quiz_json)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        @errors << "Invalid JSON"
        render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity and return
      rescue StandardError
        @errors << "Invalid JSON"
        render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity and return
      end

      unless parsed.is_a?(Hash)
        @errors << "Invalid quiz format"
        render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity and return
      end

      title_raw = parsed["title"]
      title = nil
      if !title_raw.is_a?(String) || title_raw.strip.blank?
        @errors << "Title can't be blank"
      else
        title = title_raw.strip
      end

      questions_raw = parsed["questions"]
      unless questions_raw.is_a?(Array)
        @errors << "Questions must be an array"
        # If questions missing/invalid, no further question validation possible
        render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity and return if @errors.any?
      end

      normalized = []
      if questions_raw.is_a?(Array)
        questions_raw.each_with_index do |q, idx|
          qnum = idx + 1
          unless q.is_a?(Hash)
            @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Invalid question format"
            next
          end

          # text (maps to body)
          text_raw = q["text"]
          text = nil
          text_valid = true
          if !text_raw.is_a?(String) || text_raw.strip.blank?
            @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Question can't be blank"
            text_valid = false
          else
            text = text_raw.strip
          end

          # active (optional, default true)
          active = true
          active_valid = true
          if q.key?("active")
            aval = q["active"]
            if aval == true || aval == false
              active = aval
            elsif aval.nil?
              active = true
            else
              @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Active must be true or false"
              active_valid = false
            end
          else
            active = true
          end

          # options
          opts_raw = q["options"]
          unless opts_raw.is_a?(Array)
            @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Add at least two options"
            next
          end

          rows = []
          opts_raw.each do |opt|
            unless opt.is_a?(Hash)
              @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Invalid option format"
              next
            end

            # option text
            ot_raw = opt["text"]
            ot = ""
            if ot_raw.is_a?(String)
              ot = ot_raw.strip
            elsif ot_raw.nil?
              ot = ""
            else
              # Non-string text: treat as blank so it will be filtered,
              # but also record? To follow form rules (filter blanks),
              # we just treat as blank without extra error; the count
              # validation below will produce "Add at least two options"
              # if too few remain. If it remains non-blank via to_s,
              # we would incorrectly accept numbers. So keep blank.
              ot = ""
            end

            # correct (optional, default false)
            correct = false
            if opt.key?("correct")
              cval = opt["correct"]
              if cval == true || cval == false
                correct = cval
              elsif cval.nil?
                correct = false
              else
                @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Correct must be true or false"
                correct = false
              end
            else
              correct = false
            end

            rows << { text: ot, correct: correct }
          end

          # Apply same rules as question form: filter blanks, then validate
          non_empty = rows.select { |r| r[:text].strip.present? }
          if non_empty.size < 2
            # Avoid duplicate if we already added for non-array (handled above)
            @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Add at least two options"
          elsif non_empty.none? { |r| r[:correct] }
            @errors << "Question #{qnum}: Mark at least one option as correct"
          end

          normalized << { text: text, text_valid: text_valid, active: active, active_valid: active_valid, options: non_empty }
        end
      end

      if @errors.any?
        render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity and return
      end

      quiz = nil
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        quiz = Quiz.create!(title: title)
        normalized.each_with_index do |nq, idx|
          q = quiz.questions.create!(body: nq[:text], active: nq[:active], position: idx + 1)
          nq[:options].each_with_index do |opt, oidx|
            q.options.create!(text: opt[:text], correct: !!opt[:correct], position: oidx + 1)
          end
        end
      end
      redirect_to moderate_quiz_path(quiz)
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
      @errors << e.message
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    private

    def import_json_param
      v = params[:quiz_json]
      if (v.nil? || v.to_s.blank?) && params[:import].is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
        v = params[:import][:quiz_json]
      elsif (v.nil? || v.to_s.blank?) && params[:import].is_a?(Hash)
        v = params[:import][:quiz_json] || params[:import]["quiz_json"]
      end
      # Fallback: support generic "quiz[json]" etc. for robustness
      if v.nil? || v.to_s.blank?
        v = params.dig(:quiz, :json) if params[:quiz]
      end
      v.to_s
    end
  end
end

# Quizzy Implementation Notes

## Stack
- Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, SQLite (storage/*.sqlite3), Puma, Propshaft (assets) + plain public/quizzy.css
- No Turbo/Hotwire: all forms are plain HTML (`local: true`) to keep QA browser tests deterministic.
- No external services: stylesheet + font copied verbatim to `public/` and served locally.

## Auth
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic on every `/moderate/*` route via `authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic`.
- Compares against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` / `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`; missing/wrong => 401.
- `/up` (rails/health) is outside `/moderate`, no auth.

## Data model
- `Quiz(title)` has_many `Question(position)` ordered by position.
- `Question(body, active:true, position)` has_many `Option(position)` ordered by position.
- `Option(text, correct:false, position)`.
- Positions assigned sequentially; move_up/down swaps neighbours then normalizes to 1..n.
- Preview answers stored only in encrypted cookie session (`session[:preview][quiz_id]`), never in DB.

## Key flows
- Quiz form: Title required (HTML + model), Save quiz redirects to quiz page. Edit reuses same partial; Delete quiz uses `onsubmit="return confirm(...)"` (native confirm).
- Question form: Question textarea required; option rows `options[i][text]` + `options[i][correct]`; 4 empty rows on new, existing rows on edit, `Add option` JS appends next-numbered row with labels `Option N` / `Option N is correct`. Active checkbox defaults true on new. Server filters blanks, validates >=2 options else "Add at least two options", >=1 correct else "Mark at least one option as correct". On failure re-renders with submitted rows, no DB write (transaction).
- Quiz page: `<ol class="question-list"><li class="card question-item">` each with Move up/down (POST), Active checkbox auto-submit (`onchange="this.form.submit()"`), Edit link, Delete button (native confirm). Correct options get `is-correct` (✓ green). Inactive dimmed with —.
- Preview: `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/preview?step=N` shows Nth active question. `POST .../preview/answer` records option_id in session. After answering shows Correct!/Wrong! + `is-revealed` (all correct highlighted). Next question / See score links; result shows `Score: X/Y`. `POST .../preview/reset` (Start over) clears session. Empty preview handled gracefully.

## Production concerns
- `config.hosts.clear`, `force_ssl=false`, `assume_ssl=false` for plain HTTP any-host.
- `config/database.yml` production => `storage/production.sqlite3`.
- `bin/serve` (executable): exports RAILS_ENV=production, `db:prepare`, `assets:precompile`, `exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT`.
- `public/quizzy.css` + `public/Inter-latin.woff2` copied from mockups; layout uses `<link href="/quizzy.css">` to avoid digest issues.
- Allowed labels kept exactly as visible text + `<label for>` / `aria-label` for Capybara `fill_in`/`check`/`click_on`.
- Each quiz/question in own `<li>` with controls inside; switches are real checkboxes; deletes use native `confirm()`.

## Testing
- `test/integration/quizzy_test.rb` + `edge_test.rb` cover auth, CRUD, validations, ordering, toggle, preview, empty, multi-correct, confirm presence, li structure.
- Manual browser test with Cuprite/Chromium verified Add option JS, autosave, confirms, full preview flow.
